study_design: Clinic- and community-based case-control study using unconditional logistic regression
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Mean ages for 66 (22.6%) cases and 226 (77.4%) controls were 71.9+/-11.47 and 56.7+/-12.69 years, P<.001, and median (25th, 75th percentile) fasting plasma FA were 2,447 (2,087, 3,024) and 2,373 (2,014, 2,751) microg/mL, respectively.
reason: This case-control study evaluates plasma fatty acids in relation to prostate cancer risk generally. No grade, stage, metastatic status, lethality, or other aggressive incident endpoint is analyzed in the abstract.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Unadjusted ORQ2vs.Q1 for omega-3 FAs eicosapentaenoic (EPA) and docosapentaenoic (DPA) were 0.39 (95% CI, 0.18-0.85) and 0.79 (95% CI, 0.35-1.79) respectively.
estimate_classifications.reason: The EPA estimate is reported for overall prostate cancer risk, without an aggressive disease definition.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Odds ratio (OR) of PCa risk was determined by unconditional logistic regression with the plasma FA 1st quartile as reference, controlling for age, education, waist-to-hip ratio, and family history.
estimate_classifications.reason: The nonnumeric high-versus-low row pertains to prostate cancer risk generally; the abstract provides no aggressive endpoint.
